item.title: Dust: Pretraining Transformers Without Backpropagation via Node Perturbation
item.description: Q Labs’ Dust paper trains Transformer language models using forward-only activation noise perturbation, trading extra FLOPs for lower memory bandwidth and state overhead.

item.title: Training a Personal iMessage Transformer on a Mac in 30 Minutes
item.description: Build and train a 1.38M-parameter decoder-only Transformer on your own iMessage history in 30 minutes on Apple Silicon using MLX and read-only SQLite backups.
